meta.title: Yoosr Customer Support for MENA Businesses
meta.description: Live chat, bot automation, and team inbox built for MENA businesses. Start for free.

page.tagline: Powering support teams across the region

hero.badge: Now live Web, Telegram, Facebook & Instagram
hero.headline:
The customer support platform
built for MENA
hero.description: Automate conversations with AI bots, manage your team's inbox in real time, and close every ticket <highlight>in Arabic or English</highlight> across every channel.

cta.headline: Your support team deserves better tools.
cta.description: Set up your workspace, embed the widget, and have your first bot live today no credit card required.

channels.headline: Meet your customers where they already are
channels.description: One inbox. Every channel. Conversations from Telegram, Facebook, Instagram, and your website managed in one place.

items.title: Web Chat
items.description: Embed a widget on any website with a single script tag. Fully customizable colors, position, and behavior.

items.title: Telegram
items.description: Connect your Telegram bot in minutes. Full two-way messaging with file and media support.

items.title: Facebook Messenger
items.description: Handle Messenger conversations from the same unified inbox alongside all other channels.

items.title: Instagram DMs
items.description: Manage Instagram direct messages with the same bot flows and agent tools as every other channel.

analytics.headline: See everything, improve everything
analytics.description: Every conversation generates data. Yoosr turns that data into decisions.

items.title: CSAT Tracking
items.description: Collect satisfaction ratings after every resolved conversation. See score distribution and trends over time.

items.title: Token Usage
items.description: Monitor AI token consumption per model. Understand cost per conversation and optimize your model selection.

items.title: Unanswered Queries
items.description: See exactly what questions your bot failed to answer. Use it to fill gaps in your knowledge base.

items.title: SLA Breach Rate
items.description: Track response deadline compliance per department with real-time breach alerts before it's too late.

orders.headline: Capture and manage leads from every conversation
orders.description: Turn every conversation into a lead. Track status and notify the team instantly.

items.title: Create from Chat
items.description: One click in the VisitorPanel opens a new order form pre-filled with the visitor's name and channel.

items.title: Status Tracking
items.description: Update orders from New to Confirmed to Shipped. Every change is logged in the activity timeline.

items.title: CSV Export
items.description: Download your full orders list filtered by date, status, or department. Ready for any CRM or warehouse.

items.title: Team Notifications
items.description: Agents are notified on every order update. Nothing falls through the cracks across your team.

testimonials.headline: Support teams across MENA choose Yoosr

items.quote: The bot handles 70% of our tickets automatically. Our team finally spends time on real problems instead of answering the same questions every day.
items.author: Sara Al-Amri

items.quote: Finally a platform built for our region. Arabic routing, MENA-friendly channels, and SLA tracking that actually works. Switched from a European tool and won't go back.
items.author: Karim Mansouri

items.quote: The Design Studio is genuinely different. Our ops team built and deployed a full order-tracking bot in an afternoon no developers involved.
items.author: Nour Rahmani

pricing.headline: Pricing plans for teams of all sizes
pricing.description: Choose the right plan for your business. No hidden fees.

plans.name: Free
plans.description: Perfect for testing and small personal projects.

plans.name: Pro
plans.description: For growing businesses that need advanced features.

plans.name: Business
plans.description: Scale your customer support with more seats and power.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.description: For large organizations with custom requirements.

features.headline: Every tool your support team actually needs
features.description: From the first automated reply to the final resolved ticket everything in one place.

items.title: Live Monitor
items.description: Supervise every open conversation in real time. Filter by department, agent, label, status, or SLA urgency. Join any conversation instantly.

items.title: AI Bot Studio
items.description: Build flows with 19 block types AI reply, knowledge base lookup, web requests, conditions, wait timers, and human handoff. No code required.

items.title: Knowledge Base
items.description: Upload your docs and FAQs. Bots retrieve answers via vector search not keyword matching. Accurate, source-grounded replies.

items.title: Analytics
items.description: Track CSAT scores, token usage per model, and unanswered queries. Date range filters. See exactly where your bot falls short.

items.title: SLA Tracking
items.description: Set response deadlines per department. Monitor breach risk in real time. Automatic alerts before SLA expires.

items.title: Multi-channel
items.description: Web chat, Telegram, Facebook Messenger, and Instagram DMs. One inbox for every channel your customers use.

designStudio.headline: Build any conversation flow without code
designStudio.description: Connect blocks visually. Every flow is executed server-side in real time no delays, no dropped messages.

items.title: Visual Builder
items.description: Drag and drop blocks to build any conversation flow. No coding knowledge required.

items.title: 19 Block Types
items.description: Reply, Condition, AI Task, Ask KB, Web Request, Wait, HITL Handoff, Apply Label and more.

items.title: Live Execution
items.description: Flows run server-side in real time. No delays, no dropped messages, no polling.

items.title: Built-in Debugger
items.description: Step through every block execution and inspect state at each node as it runs.

howItWorks.headline: Live in minutes, not weeks
howItWorks.description: No infrastructure to manage. No long onboarding. Just build your bot and go live.

steps.title: Create your workspace
steps.description: Sign up, create a Clerk organization, and your Convex project is provisioned instantly. Invite your team in seconds.

steps.title: Build your bot
steps.description: Open the Design Studio. Drag blocks, set conditions, connect your knowledge base. Publish when ready.

steps.title: Go live everywhere
steps.description: Paste one script tag on your site. Connect Telegram, Facebook, or Instagram from the Integrations page. Done.
